title: CRISPR-based screening of small RNA modulators of bile susceptibility in Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron
model: Bacteroides thetaiotaomicron VPI-5482, CRISPRi (dPb2Cas12a) library of 135 intergenic sRNAs
contrast: Bile salts vs no bile, rich medium at stationary phase (3 vs 3)
paper_method: edgeR per guide, averaged per sRNA (|log2FC|>0.5, FDR<0.05)
barcs_calls: 3 sRNAs at FDR 0.10 (BTnc353, BatR, BTnc242); 20 controls, no control null
verdict: BARCS calls the paper's two sRNA hits as its top two, with matching directions (BatR enriched under bile, BTnc353 depleted), and adds one borderline call; effect sizes are smaller than edgeR's averaged per-guide logFC.
